The '''Ranger''' was a model of [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The driver rode at the front of the Ranger, which had engine flaps that could move up and down.

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectron Ranger was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[July 22]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Outer Rim Explorer's Pack on the Cartel Market. It is one of the first vehicles to feature a "flourish;" in the Ranger's case, the engine flaps move up and down.
